justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Exercise for aging adults is well-evidenced; CEEAA-specific outcomes not studied.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: CEEAA online coursework plus field experience; moderate cost; accessible self-directed pathway.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any clinician working with older adults on exercise prescription; broad geriatric caseload utility.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Exercise for aging adults billed under standard PT codes; no CEEAA billing premium in current payer contracts.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Moderate awareness in geriatric PT/OT; not widely listed as required but growing recognition.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Older adults value clinicians knowledgeable about age-specific exercise.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Active-aging and fall-prevention markets have a growing self-pay segment, especially in affluent retirement areas.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Moderate — fitness-adjacent pricing with some clinical premium.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Useful niche signal but not rare; competes with many aging-adult fitness brands.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Trainable to staff; supports a class-and-group-based scalable model.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Some consumer recognition through Geriatrics Section visibility.
justifications.business.efficiency: Reasonable cost and time relative to other certs.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Modest recognition within geriatrics-focused programs only.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Tied to APTA Geriatrics community with some scholarly output.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Strengthens geriatrics and exercise prescription teaching.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Built on solid exercise-and-aging RCT literature.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely required in postings; more of a nice-to-have.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Affordable and quick relative to academic value provided.
